import re
def safe_slug_filename(name, max_len):
    lowered = name.lower()
    replaced = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', lowered)
    trimmed = replaced.strip('-')
    truncated = trimmed[:max_len]
    return truncated.rstrip('-')

def format_currency_suffix(amount, code):
    is_negative = amount < 0
    value = -amount if is_negative else amount
    text = "{:,.2f}".format(value)
    sign = "-" if is_negative else ""
    return sign + text + " " + code

def weighted_leaderboard(entries, w1, w2):
    scored = []
    for name, a, b in entries:
        score = w1 * a + w2 * b
        scored.append((name, score))
    scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
    return [name for name, score in scored]

    items = list(nums)
    items.sort(key=lambda x: x)
    items.sort(key=lambda x: abs(x), reverse=True)
